_comment: AgriVault ESP#1 → ESP#2 JSON Bridge Communication File
_description: This file documents the exact data format flowing between ESP#1 (Sensor Sender) and ESP#2 (JSON Forwarder). It is NOT used at runtime — both ESPs communicate via UART Serial2 using the pipe-delimited string format. This file serves as the developer reference and can also be used to test the backend API manually.

uart_wire_protocol._note: This is the ACTUAL real-time format ESP#1 sends to ESP#2 over Serial2 (UART). One line per second, newline-terminated.

fields.name: header
fields.description: Packet sentinel — ESP#2 validates this before parsing

fields.name: rssi
fields.description: RSSI placeholder — ESP#1 has no WiFi, always 0

json_payload_sent_to_backend._note: This is the JSON that ESP#2 builds from the UART data and HTTP POSTs to /api/devices/telemetry every 1 second.

fields.deviceId: string  — ID of ESP#1 (the sensor node), forwarded by ESP#2
fields.hardwareType: string  — board type of ESP#1, e.g. 'ESP32-DevKit-V1'
fields.timestamp: string  — ISO 8601 UTC timestamp (use NTP for real time)
fields.rssi: number  — int, dBm (0 = ESP#1 has no WiFi)
fields.forwarderId: string  — MAC-derived ID of ESP#2 itself
fields.forwarderRssi: number  — int, dBm WiFi signal strength of ESP#2

backend_response._note: Backend responds to every successful POST with this ACK. ESP#2 checks HTTP code 200/201.

wiring.esp1_tx2_gpio17: → ESP#2 RX Pin D5 (GPIO 14)  (data flows this way)
wiring.esp1_rx2_gpio16: ← ESP#2 TX Pin D6 (GPIO 12)  (optional ACK, not used by default)
wiring.shared_gnd: ESP#1 GND → ESP#2 GND         (REQUIRED — common ground)
